uiExemptions.reason: Main-process refactor only: the CLI's spawn options move into one shared helper (cliSpawn) that the test runner also uses. Same options, nothing on screen changes.

Main-process only: every CLI start moves into app/main/cli-spawn.js, which refuses outside a packaged build unless the run recorded the server; the CLI's error texts drop the command name. Nothing on screen changes; a refused import shows the existing error line.

Main-process only: the CLI fence decides packaged from the app.asar location, reads the dev opt-in from the main process command line, and allows only Barkdown's own CLI verbs. Nothing on screen changes.
Main-process only: a dev-app relaunch keeps the CLI opt-in, and the dev app's document server refuses the CLI in plain words. Nothing on screen changes.
Main-process only: the control socket refuses, in the dev app, commands that can change the library setting and, while the library is the CLI, commands that reach it. Nothing on screen changes.
Main-process only: in the dev app with the CLI library, the control socket runs only the commands it answers itself. Nothing on screen changes.
